Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver

Class DesktopMode.Capability

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.DesktopMode.Capability
Enclosing class:
DesktopMode
public static final class DesktopMode.Capability extends Object
What the probe found out about this machine's 3D support.

getReason() is non-null exactly when 3D is unavailable and carries a human-readable explanation for the prompt / error dialog.
